Place_Chi: 日本本州西部南海岸近岸
Place_Por: Junto à costa sul de Honshu oeste, Japão
Place_Eng: Near South Coast of Western Honshu, Japan

Chinese: 地震報告: 根據地球物理氣象局初步分析，本地時間2026年11月01日06時15分02秒，於日本本州西部南海岸近岸發生6.0級地震，震源深度約為350公里，震中約位於北緯33.80度，東經137.00度，距離澳門東北約2631公里。
Portuguese: Comunicado de sismo: A DSMG informa que no dia 01-11-2026 pelas 06:15:02 (hora local) foi registado um sismo de magnitude 6.0, profundidade 350 km, e cujo epicentro se localizou a cerca de 2631 km a nordeste de Macau, (33,80N, 137,00E), Junto à costa sul de Honshu oeste, Japão.
English: Earthquake Report: Initial analysis from Meteorological and Geophysical Bureau indicated that an earthquake of magnitude 6.0 , focal depth of 350 km, has occurred at 06:15:02 on 01 November 2026 (local time) in Near South Coast of Western Honshu, Japan. The epicentre is located near 33.80N, 137.00E, about 2631 kilometres northeast of Macao.
